temporal_display.method: Cross-dissolve adjacent original raster states. No particle-position interpolation or new contact dynamics.
temporal_display.clock: Display time between the two bracketing saved times; not a newly integrated state.
temporal_display.speed: 0–0.2 s: 0.05x; 0.2–6 s: 0.30x. No long still-image holds.
temporal_display.exit: Zoom dissolve ends exactly at the recorded absorbing crossing; no post-exit ghost.

zoom.transform: Translation only x_i-x_0, identical camera orientation, isotropic scale
zoom.connection: True 50 um cube plus enlarged locator at its center; two leaders to zoom corners
zoom.locator_motion: Display chord only, clipped at the recorded crossing; no effect on particle geometry

field.slices: XY z=0 and YZ x=0 at native resolution

science_scope: Original sealed Stage 4I B2/B3. Spatial aggregation is not fusion. Existing near-contact, near-wall and finite-Re limitations remain.
